name: SoloMD
tagline: A small markdown editor that AI tools can plug into
description:
SoloMD is a fast, local-first editor for markdown notes — the plain-text format used for readmes, docs and to-do lists. It is only a few megabytes and keeps your files on your own device.

It also ships a bridge that lets AI coding tools read and edit those notes for you, which turns your phone into a place where notes and assistants meet.
